description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
